name: cross-agent-review
description: One-shot, read-only file reviews between Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and xAI Grok on Windows. Install the plugins for the reviewers you want to call, not the one you are chatting with.

plugins.name: review-with-claude
plugins.description: Ask Claude Code to review named files. Install in Codex or Grok.

plugins.name: review-with-codex
plugins.description: Ask OpenAI Codex to review named files. Install in Claude Code or Grok.

plugins.name: review-with-grok
plugins.description: Ask xAI Grok to review named files. Install in Claude Code or Codex.
